entities.name: Hermenegildo González
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hermenegildo González or Mendo I Gonçalves was a Galician count in the 10th century Kingdom of León, tenente in Deza, and the ancestor of one of the most relevant Galaico-Portuguese lineages of the Early Middle Ages. He appears in medieval charters confirming as Ermegildus Gundisaluis.
